notes: Zertal 2005 Site 154 ('Ein Abu Daraj Fort; entry grid 1911/1699, 100 m from the unit point) describes a fort tower, a western and an eastern courtyard, walls, threshold and jamb stones. It describes no pool, pit or grave, so features is empty. The water source is the 'Ein Abu Daraj spring, 300 m away; it is a spring, not a pool. Plan Fig. 296 (p. 417) labels no pool, pit or grave (one small unlabelled mark north of the courtyard is not identified in the text). The header field 'Cisterns: none' is recorded as an explicit C2 absence, but it covers cisterns only.
